experiment: state-dependent radial feed-forward empirical CVaR search

scope.sample_use: all fixed paths are used for fitting and full-sample replay

architecture.network: one independent two-hidden-layer FeedForward action per lambda
architecture.action_map: a=v/(1+||v||_1), so a=0 is feasible with a nonzero local derivative
architecture.extreme_tail_continuation: full-batch continuation from the preceding lower-lambda action

interpretation.positive_CVaR: a constructive lower bound proving that the tested lambda is too small for the learned strategy class
interpretation.zero_CVaR: no positive direction was found; this is not a global certificate because the network optimization is non-convex
interpretation.surviving_paths: support of one exact CVaR subgradient density for the selected fitted action; it is not a martingale density when fitted CVaR is positive
interpretation.zero_action_density: at a zero action the CVaR subgradient is non-unique, so its one-path support is arbitrary and is not reported as a martingale result

pca_iv.full_sample_transition_statement: the frozen learned candidate is positive at 8e6 and negative at 1e7

dysanos.full_sample_transition_statement: the frozen learned candidate is positive at 1e7 and negative at 2e7

conclusion.reason: positive objectives persist to extreme caps, while the first zero result is only a non-convex optimizer outcome; surviving-tail ESS collapses to single digits and rare full-sample losses are absent from ordinary monitoring minibatches
conclusion.comparison_with_hard_partition: the richer feed-forward class invalidates the much smaller hard-64-partition cap as a strategy-class-independent answer
